title: Jim Co NDE 21025
content:
I can’t remember everything in detail since it was so long ago. I was around ten years old or so. My family was at a state park, and I was swimming in the lake. At that time, I didn’t know how to swim--so you can say I was just ‘playing’. Since I tended to be somewhat mischievous, I kept going out into deeper water. I intended to stop once it was up to my chin area. What I didn’t realize was that there was an immediate five foot drop-off just after the area enclosed by a line with buoys on it. I went immediately under and was fighting to get to the top. After thrashing around for a short period I distinctly remember a tremendous jerk within my mind, almost like something automatically was occurring that was a natural part of the dying process. And then suddenly I was outside of my body floating in this semi-conscious state. I was completely content and was not struggling anymore. In fact, I was unbelievable happy and felt like I was enveloped by a loving presence. The next thing I remember was my father dragging me out of the deep end into the shallow area. Quite honestly, I was disappointed because I did not want to leave this state. I was so happy there. My father got me to shore and I recovered. He came into the lake with his clothes on and then when he was out of the water he started taking his money out of his wallet and drying it on the sand. I remember him saying ‘you were just about a goner.’

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Floating outside of body in a semi-conscious state; completely content and not struggling; 'unbelievable happy' and 'enveloped by a loving presence.'

arrival.other_being_detail: A loving presence was felt; no being visually described.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Return coincided with father dragging him from deep water into shallow area and to shore.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning in a lake after stepping off a drop-off into deep water.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Felt a 'tremendous jerk within my mind' preceding the out-of-body floating state; felt enveloped by a loving presence.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Drowning struggle → 'tremendous jerk within my mind' → out-of-body floating/content/loving presence → father drags him out (return). No tunnel, no life review, no boundary described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Described a 'tremendous jerk within my mind' as if an automatic part of the dying process, immediately followed by being outside his body in a semi-conscious, content state.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “a tremendous jerk within my mind”; “outside of my body floating in this semi-conscious state”; “unbelievable happy and felt like I was enveloped by a loving presence”; “you were just about a goner.”
